follow-on: the added mock branch implements its own fold_receipt selection, but the test fixture contains no receipt-backed live superseded name, so the idempotence test never proves a positive revival or an unreceipted exclusion through this graph model.

follow-on: the production loop logs when total_changed is nonzero but prints only drafted, superseded and quarantined; a revival-only run therefore reports zero in every displayed category despite the new revived count, hiding the repair from this summary.
